localized_texts.zh: 那件事后，我和妈妈通电话，把我们一起解谜的事情告诉了她。我说，其实我一直觉得自己不够好，也好几次想要放弃。每当这时，前辈都会安慰我，告诉我：即便失败也没关系。或许就是想到这些，我才能战胜暗面中的那个我……妈妈听了后好久没说话，我问她怎么了，她才和我说：一直以来辛苦了。我……我没想到她会这样说，但闭上眼睛，我想：真好啊。
localized_texts.en: After what happened, I called Mother and told her everything. About the riddles we solved together, how I'd been scared I wasn't good enough, and the times I almost gave up. And how every time, you were there to comfort me, telling me it was okay, even if I failed. Maybe that's how I managed to overcome the version of me in the Dark Side. Mother... She went quiet for a long time. When I asked if she was alright, she finally said, "You've been carrying so much all this time." I... I never thought she'd say that. But then I closed my eyes and thought: That feels really, really good.
